answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in vertex and horizon lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the ferrous graph. A farm of 4602 identities would post 2106 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
